title: GrowthTrack redesign research and implementation plan

directionsConfirmed.visual: Refine the existing calm editorial style and improve usability

sources.title: Blender: viewport navigation
sources.finding: Visible orientation, orbit, pan and zoom controls supplement gestures and hardware-specific shortcuts.
sources.adaptation: Provide visible fit/front/side/back and zoom actions for laptop trackpads; avoid requiring a numpad or middle mouse button.
sources.method: Official indexed documentation; direct fetch failed, so only the returned indexed navigation description was used.

sources.title: Blender: contextual sidebar
sources.finding: Item, Tool and View separate object properties from tool and camera settings.
sources.adaptation: Keep the body inspector contextual and move camera/render settings out of measurement editing.

sources.title: Linear: display options
sources.finding: Grouping, ordering and layout options belong to the active view and can be retained as personal preferences.
sources.adaptation: Use a stable list toolbar and optional saved view preferences without proliferating permanent page controls.
sources.method: Official documentation opened during this research.

sources.title: Actual Budget: transaction filters
sources.finding: Composable filters support focused transaction summaries and saved selections.
sources.adaptation: Keep ledger search and active filters visible; show advanced filter construction on request and validate resulting totals independently.
sources.method: Official documentation opened during this research. Its documented limitations are not adopted as requirements.

sources.title: Cronometer: chart library
sources.finding: Time-series charts are selected by recorded biometric or nutrient, with optional configurable charts.
sources.adaptation: Keep logging separate from exploration; name the measurement, date range, units and source for each wellness chart.
sources.method: Official documentation opened during this research; used for interaction design, not medical interpretation.

sources.title: Notion: views, filters and sorts
sources.finding: View configuration and record opening are distinct; records may open in a side panel, centered panel or full page.
sources.adaptation: Keep list context when inspecting tasks/files/notes; use a full-page or stacked alternative on narrow screens.

sources.title: FullCalendar: accessibility
sources.finding: Calendar headings and interactive events need deliberate keyboard and labeling behavior.
sources.adaptation: Test every date/event action, supply an agenda alternative and verify focus order rather than assuming a calendar grid is accessible.
sources.method: Official indexed documentation. This is a reference pattern, not a dependency recommendation.

sources.title: W3C: reflow
sources.finding: Ordinary content must reflow at 320 CSS pixels without losing information or functionality; essential two-dimensional surfaces have exceptions.
sources.adaptation: Test the UI around 3D/maps/tables at zoom and narrow widths; the canvas exception does not exempt its surrounding forms and buttons.
sources.method: Official W3C explanatory document opened during this research.

sources.title: W3C: focus not obscured
sources.finding: Author-created sticky elements must not completely hide a focused control.
sources.adaptation: Review header, inspector, mobile dock and dialogs with keyboard navigation; prefer full focused-control visibility as a product target.
sources.method: Official W3C explanatory document opened during this research.

sources.title: W3C: target size
sources.finding: WCAG 2.2 AA defines 24 CSS pixel targets with specified exceptions; larger targets support easier activation.
sources.adaptation: Retain this app’s stronger 44 CSS pixel control target; do not shrink controls to fit a laptop.
sources.method: Official W3C explanatory document opened during this research.

findings.title: The model is below the initial laptop viewport
findings.evidence: At 1366×768 the 3D entry screenshot shows the page title, five-view tabs, a second introduction, person card and editor selector; the model is below the visible bottom edge.
findings.decision: Combine identity, saved state and workspace selection into compact controls and put the model in the first screen.

findings.title: 3D controls compete across several control systems
findings.evidence: The captured Measure state contains 119 visible DOM controls across the scrollable page, and Face contains 137. Controls counted include inputs, links, summary toggles and tabs; these are scope indicators, not a usability score.
findings.decision: Keep Current/Goal/Compare as the main mode switch and use a task-based inspector; retain specialist controls in secondary studio sections.

findings.title: Measurements expose a large editing surface
findings.evidence: The synthetic populated Measurements view contains 182 visible DOM controls and a 2026px document height at 1366×768.
findings.decision: Open Essentials first; use region selection, search and a focused guidance panel; preserve all existing fields and unit parsing.

findings.title: Recorded values and artistic edits need clearer context
findings.evidence: Body tracker and Parametric human editor are separate switches. Source explicitly stores artistic shape controls separately and gives the parametric editor three export formats.
findings.decision: Use clearly named body tracking and appearance workspaces with persistent person/context labels; preserve independent records.

findings.title: Page hierarchy and visual language vary across modules
findings.evidence: 21 of the 60 inspected default pages expose no visible H1 in the captured main region. Editorial pages coexist with blue utility controls, large gradient banners and legacy uppercase titles. H1 presence is a semantic consistency finding, not proof of accessibility conformance.
findings.decision: Use the existing editorial tokens and shared page header; reconcile the conflicting historical design documents.

findings.title: Daily logging can be displaced by secondary tools
findings.evidence: Nutrition’s first screen contains the macro calculator and BMR explanation rather than Log meal; captured document height is 2876px.
findings.decision: Lead with the diary and logging action; place calculator assumptions and educational content in secondary views.

findings.title: App discovery requires a long catalog scan
findings.evidence: App Hub contains 153 visible DOM controls over a 4285px captured document; search/area discovery comes after pinned tools and companion introductions.
findings.decision: Bring search and area filters into the first screen; use compact results and disambiguate Overview by area.

findings.title: Some screens have overlapping jobs
findings.evidence: Lifestyle and Habits both present Habit Matrix; five domain overviews, Apps, Apps Suite and companion pages create several navigation summaries.
findings.decision: Give every route a distinct purpose while retaining current URLs; do not merge stores or delete destinations during styling work.

findings.title: Companion wrappers add their own chrome and vertical constraints
findings.evidence: UnifiedWorkspace adds a second header and toolbar; its iframe style has a 700px minimum height. This audit deliberately shows offline companion fixtures, not authenticated inner products.
findings.decision: Use a compact host frame and separately verify each embedded product, authentication flow and scrolling behavior.

phases.name: Approve the research and implementation scope
phases.work: Approve the comparison-first 3D wireframe, the refined editorial direction and the route-by-route backlog. Confirm any exclusions explicitly.
phases.done: Written approval in chat. The earlier preference answers are direction only, not implementation approval.

phases.name: Lock shared contracts and representative layouts
phases.work: Reconcile design docs; confirm semantic tokens, header, toolbar, form, state and record-detail patterns. Create comparison, record-list and command-page reference layouts. Record baselines with isolated fixtures.
phases.done: Approved reference screens at 1280×720, 1366×768 and 1920×1080; dark/light and keyboard review; route and state contracts enumerated.
phases.risk: Avoid replacing the stylesheet stack wholesale; migrate one component family at a time.

phases.name: Deliver the body-tracking and comparison workspace first
phases.work: Remove duplicate introductions in 3D mode, compact the person selector, keep one Current/Goal/Compare switch, put the model and contextual measurement inspector in the first viewport, add explicit no-goal/no-history guidance.
phases.done: First usable viewer and active mode visible without scrolling at 1280×720; fit/front/side/back and keyboard editing work; save state stays in view; Current/Goal separation and check-in behavior survive reload.
phases.risk: Keep renderer inputs, measurement conversions, protected capture rules and store schemas stable. Change the shell before changing engine behavior.

phases.name: Complete the Physique record views and secondary studio
phases.work: Refine Blueprint, Essentials/regions, Targets and History; reorganize Face/Hair/Skin/Anatomy/Clothing/Pose/View as secondary studio tools. Add one explicit export flow identifying the current capabilities of each format.
phases.done: All five Physique views and eight inspector sections have desktop/mobile evidence; the parametric editor retains its independent Current/Goal document and import review; unsupported asset controls explain availability.
phases.risk: Appearance work must never mutate tracker measurements. No new asset family or source-channel expansion is implied by the redesign.

phases.name: Roll out daily record pages
phases.dependency: P0; begin after the approved 3D slice
phases.work: Migrate Nutrition, Hydration, Sleep, Mind, Habits, Tasks, Notes, Calendar and Timesheet using the shared patterns; preserve domain-specific behavior.
phases.done: Primary daily task is reachable in the first viewport; populated, empty, filtered-empty, loading, error and save-failure states are verified with fixtures. Existing drafts/revisions/timers remain intact.
phases.risk: Existing functional gaps remain separate work items; do not silently change financial, recurrence or clinical logic.

phases.name: Migrate Finance and the remaining domain pages
phases.work: Implement every remaining native route in the page matrix, grouped by shared template. Preserve financial assumptions, units, source dates and unavailable data distinctions.
phases.done: All 60 canonical routes are accounted for; the 191 registered secondary-view entries each have a route/state check or an explicit unsupported-view finding, with no silent deletion.
phases.risk: Land by coherent page family rather than a repository-wide visual replacement.

phases.name: Companion and public-screen finishing
phases.dependency: P0 patterns and authenticated companion test fixtures
phases.work: Refine the five host frames; review each listed inner companion route with an isolated identity before styling it; align shared adapters and public/login/legal layouts without removing product-specific workflows.
phases.done: Inner route inventory is independently checked, including handoff expiry, offline/retry and nested scrolling. Public login errors, privacy/terms reading and return navigation work at laptop and zoomed widths.
phases.risk: Source inventory is not authenticated browser acceptance. No companion data migration, native parity or integration completion claim.

phases.name: Acceptance and handoff
phases.work: Run the viewport/state/keyboard matrix, before/after review, focused functional suites, changed-file lint, production build and protected 3D export/capture checks. Report exceptions explicitly.
phases.done: Evidence includes route/view, fixture state, viewport, theme, screenshot and check result. Rollback is by page family; no deployment is implied by plan approval.
phases.risk: A viewport audit is not physical laptop certification or independent usability testing.

limitations: Synthetic empty/default records and explicit unavailable service fixtures; no owner records opened or modified.
60 host routes and 15 additional Physique/editor states were captured. The 191 secondary-view entries were inventoried, not all browser-exercised.
Companion inner routes are source-reviewed only; authenticated screenshots and functional acceptance remain required before their implementation.
This is an expert design review and source comparison, not a participant usability study, physical-device certificate or human-model realism certification.
Some initial captures include transient loading states. Targeted recaptures wait for loading indicators; unavailable fixture services remain deliberately unavailable.

approval.scope: Approved phased plan; no deployment, migrations or replacement assets.
